description_en: A low sling chair with one flexible woven seat-and-back suspended between two inclined side rails; the front shows the hanging woven cradle, the side reveals the continuous suspended curve, and the rear shows the upper suspension bar and diagonal A-frame supports. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
